playbook.claim: Generate marketing copy from the audience’s immediate pre-purchase problem scene, then iterate it through a structured create-publish-observe-revise loop.
playbook.mechanism: Problem-specific scenes can make copy feel personally recognizable, while repeated measured iteration identifies language that earns attention and downstream action.

playbook.claim: Test letting users record an affirmation in their own voice and replay it as part of the daily affirmation ritual.
playbook.mechanism: Personal voice recording may increase perceived ownership and make repeated practice more emotionally salient; compare recording-enabled and text-only cohorts on completion, repeat sessions, reminder opens, and conversion.

playbook.claim: Offer an anonymous question-box experience as the first interaction before asking users to start a direct chat or call.
playbook.mechanism: A low-commitment, identity-light question can reduce the friction of initiating personal support; compare question-box-first onboarding with direct-consultation onboarding on first-action completion, counselor contact, paid usage, and retention.
